label: A power over a thing's esse works on its potency not to be or is a CAUSE_2 of its esse
paraphrase: OPEN (correlation), analyst formulation, attribution deferred (navigation: Met. Theta.1 1046a, active power correlates with passive potency; ST I q.104 a.3, annihilation as ceasing to give being, not an action on a patient): for all y and x, if y has power over x's esse, then x can fail to be in substance (corruptible simply: the power works on x's intrinsic potency to non-being) or y causes x's esse (CAUSE_2 at esse: the power is the giving and withholding of being). CausesIn is tenseless here, so a conserving cause and a cause that only originated x are not distinguished; the deist rival targets exactly that reading (controls, deistSource).
